→ Smooth the top of the chip bag 
→ Fold both upper corners inward, forming a triangular point at the top
→ Starting at the point, fold the bag downward toward you until you have reached the bottom of the triangular folds
→ Take the two corners and tuck them underneath the existing fold to hold everything together
